name: Sacred Servant
summary: A deity's devoted champion who gains a domain, dedicated domain spell slots, a holy-symbol bond, and celestial allies.

features.name: Sacred Deity
features.summary: Choose one lawful good, lawful neutral, or neutral good deity to worship.

features.name: Sacred Servant Smite Evil
features.summary: Smite evil as a Paladin, with additional daily uses at 7th level and every 6 levels thereafter.

features.name: Sacred Servant Spellcasting
features.summary: Cast Paladin spells normally and gain one dedicated domain spell slot for each Paladin spell level you can cast.
features.scaling: 1st through 4th-level Paladin spells plus domain slots

features.name: Sacred Domain
features.summary: Choose one domain associated with your deity; its effective Cleric level equals Paladin level –3.

features.name: 1st-level Domain Spell Slot
features.summary: Prepare the 1st-level spell from your selected domain in this dedicated slot.

features.name: 2nd-level Domain Spell Slot
features.summary: Prepare the 2nd-level spell from your selected domain in this dedicated slot.

features.name: 3rd-level Domain Spell Slot
features.summary: Prepare the 3rd-level spell from your selected domain in this dedicated slot.

features.name: 4th-level Domain Spell Slot
features.summary: Prepare the 4th-level spell from your selected domain in this dedicated slot.

features.name: Holy Symbol Bond
features.summary: Bind a celestial spirit to your holy symbol to improve Paladin caster level, channel energy, channel damage, or lay on hands.
features.scaling: one enhancement at 5th level and one more every 3 levels
features.uses: 1/day plus one use every 4 levels after 5th

features.name: Call Celestial Ally
features.summary: Cast lesser planar ally without payment for a reasonable task.
features.scaling: planar ally at 12th; greater planar ally at 16th

features.name: Call Celestial Ally (Planar Ally)
features.summary: Your weekly celestial ally improves to planar ally.

features.name: Call Celestial Ally (Greater)
features.summary: Your weekly celestial ally improves to greater planar ally.
